title: 777 Prayer
subtitle: 7 Bartizans · 7 Journeys · 7 Guideposts
intro: The 7 bartizans are inside of me, the 7 journeys lie ahead of me, and the 7 guideposts are my background — the prayer a Remnant holds onto every day.

items.name: The Triune God
items.sum: God the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit
prayer: May the Triune God work inside of me.
May You take control of my heart, my thoughts, my body and my soul.

items.name: The Throne
rows: Blessing of the throne · Beyond time and space · Light to the 237 nations
Image [[GEN 1:27]] · Breath of life [[GEN 2:7]] · Blessing of Eden [[GEN 2:1-19]]
prayer: May the power of the throne come upon me.
May Your kingdom be fulfilled.
May the transcendence of time and space and the power to reach the 237 nations come upon me.
May this power come upon my life.
May it come upon my soul.
May it come upon my daily life.
And in my life and in my studies, in my church and my field, may I have this unprecedented, never repeated answers.

items.name: 3 Eras
prayer: God, may You work upon my past, my present and future in power.

items.name: The Universe
items.sum: Authority to defeat Satan, the ruler of the air
prayer: Grant me the power to transcend time and space and to overcome the ruler of the kingdom of the air.

items.name: 5 Powers
items.sum: Spiritual · Intellectual · Physical · Economic · Human resources
prayer: At this time God, may You give me the five authorities.

items.name: CVDIP in Advance
prayer: Right now, grant me the blessing of seeing the CVDIP in advance.

items.name: 3 Courtyards
prayer: May the power of the three courtyards come upon me.

items.name: Blessing of the Throne
items.sum: The Triune God with me, with us, with all things
rows: The Triune God with me (With), with us (Immanuel), and with all things (Oneness)
prayer: God, fill me and lead me on the path of the Triune God.
I have many hardships.

items.name: 10 Mysteries
items.sum: Independence · Spiritual facts · Reverse thinking · Synergy · Crisis …
rows: Independence · Spiritual facts · Reverse thinking · Synergy · Crisis · No competition · Re-creation · Summit · Wilderness · Absolute
prayer: Help me enjoy the ten mysteries so I can find the path that You are directing me on.

items.name: 10 Foundations
items.sum: God's sovereignty · way · power · guarantee · temple …
rows: JX, the main character of history
The work of the Holy Spirit
Where I am is the mission field
Lord of life, death, fortune and misfortune
prayer: People just think whatever they want, they talk and say whatever they want, and they add things to that as well.
God may the ten foundations be established in me.

items.name: 5 Assurances
items.sum: Salvation · Answered prayer · Victory · Forgiveness · Guidance
prayer: There is no hardship that can overcome the Gospel.
So may the five assurances work upon me as my answer.

items.name: 9 Streams
prayer: I must change America.
By Your power, help me enjoy the nine streams.

items.name: 62 Lives of an Evangelist
items.sum: 21 lives · 5 prayer mysteries · 7 summits · 9 streams · 20 strategies
rows:
Calvary [[ACT 1:1]] · Mount of Olives [[ACT 1:3]] God's kingdom · Mark's upper room [[ACT 1:8]] power

5 foundations: Darakbang · Team ministry · Mission home · Specialized church · Branch church
5 trainings: Retreat · Team retreat · Field (70) retreat · Specialized retreat · Intensive (evangelism) retreat
5 organizations: Evangelism school · Evangelism seminary · Missionary training center · RTS · RU
5 futures: Elite · Culture · Industry · Healing · Remnant
prayer: God, grant me the answer I can enjoy for the rest of my life.

items.name: The Church (Worship)
items.sum: World evangelization through the church and worship
rows: Because the blessing of the throne works in the church and in worship, the world is evangelized through the church and worship.
prayer: I'm going to such and such a place today.
May that become the camp.

items.name: Calvary
prayer: Wherever I go, may the power of the cross, the power of the blood come.

items.name: Mount of Olives
prayer: Wherever I go, may the covenant of the Mount of Olives, the things pertaining to God's kingdom, be fulfilled.

items.name: Mark's Upper Room
prayer: May Your works that took place in Mark's upper room take place in me.

items.name: Antioch
prayer: May Your time schedule that appeared in Antioch appear in me.

items.name: Asia
prayer: Paul's first missions field, Asia, where he was able to find all the answers, may You grant me those works.

items.name: Macedonia
prayer: And the life turning point that Paul's team found, may I find that.

items.name: Rome
prayer: May I see Rome.

closing: The seven bartizans are inside of me.
And the seven journeys lie ahead of me.
And the seven guideposts are my background.
source: 777 Prayer (RCA ver.) — World Evangelization Evangelism Alliance
